description: Separate from provider UFCalendar metadata. Only independently checked complete UFC fight listings with source-linked bout-by-bout identities may establish full-career verification. No fighter is independently certified merely because every currently known UFC fight is indexed and measured. Minimum-count evidence may prove historical omissions but cannot certify full-career completeness, even if its minimum is met.

bruno-gustavo-da-silva.note: UFC official flyweight Bruno Silva (NOT middleweight Bruno Silva 'Blindado') lists 12 UFC appearances through 6 June 2026, including losses to Charles Johnson and Edgar Chairez in 2026; the immutable approved roster snapshot has a stale 2025-10-18 most-recent UFC date. This is a minimum count/source-confirmed gap, never independent full-career certification. The complete dated bout inventory lives in data/ufc-official-career-bout-inventory.json.

carlos-hernandez-7.note: Official UFC history lists seven UFC fights between 2022 and May 2025; only one saved under the approved disambiguated slug.
